description:
Fast, local-first desktop app for notes, journaling, and knowledge work.

Skriuw is a fast, local-first desktop app for notes, journaling, and knowledge work. Version 2 keeps the workspace in local SQLite storage with portable archives and Git-backed history.
Highlights
Opening files keeps them in sync (#524). Opening a Markdown, MDX or text file from the file manager imports it as a note. Opening the same file again later updates that note:
- If only the file changed, the note takes the file's text.
- If only the note changed, the note is kept.
- If both changed, the note opens right away and a dialog asks whether to keep the note, use the file, or keep both.
- A file that was moved is recognised by its contents.
.txt files can now be opened. Imported titles come from frontmatter title:, then a leading # heading, then the file name, and notes keep their file's created and modified times. MDX imports without loss: components and import/export lines become mdx code blocks, and inline tags and {expressions} become inline code. This applies to folder imports too.
Account deletion (#525). Settings, Account & sync can permanently delete your cloud account, its synced workspace, your shared notes and every Skriuw workspace on this device. The sign-in record is removed only after the cloud data is purged. Copies on other devices stay until they are cleared there. Details in ADR-0056.
Clean up empty notes (#525). "Clean up empty notes" in the command palette, or the row under Settings, Data & recovery, moves every note with no body beyond its title to the trash, with one undo. Pinned, locked, journal, commented and parent notes, and notes with properties or decorations, are never touched.
Settings
- Search matches the text of every row, not just section names, and shows the matching row under the result. Multi-word searches prefer sections that contain the whole phrase (#523).
- Keyboard focus fades in as a soft fill instead of an outline, across the settings dialog and the media preview. Theme cards, fields and the search box lift their border on focus, and buttons press in slightly. The switch is redrawn with a filled track (#523).
Command palette
- Themes are one picker. Press Space on any "Theme:" row to list only themes, and Backspace to go back (#525).
- Settings, Appearance, Command palette size offers Default, Roomy and Large (#525).
Mobile
- Sign in from the account sheet. The app stores the credential in the platform keystore, opens the account's own workspace and syncs it through the native core on Android and iOS. Switching accounts remounts the workspace, and returning to the app catches up on remote changes (#527).
- Lock settings open from a Security row in the account sheet. Notes and folders in the tree have a Lock/Unlock action and show a lock marker (#526).
Fixes and polish
- Desktop: the splash is part of the main window instead of a separate window, and a file opened from the file manager is already the active note on the first frame (#525).
- Shared controls outside settings show keyboard focus with a border colour instead of an outline ring (#525).
Site
- Release notes on the changelog render with marked. A generated comment in one older release no longer shows as text (#519).
- The site code is reorganised into flat modules. Pages look the same (#519, #521).
Full changelog: v2-v0.49.0...v2-v0.50.0
